thread:
lina.marketing: Quick sync 6; VeroHealth case story logistics. Customer offered a short case study + a co-hosted webinar slot. Need legal ok for webinar script and a single topline quote. Also want to coordinate webinar promotion cadence.

carlos.cs: Webinar is great. We'll need to confirm which VeroHealth environment was used for tests and if PHI was present. If PHI was involved we need the private deployment disclaimer.

ben.pm: We should align the promo timeline: 2 weeks of social + email + a partner invite list. Draft timeline: week 0 announce + registration, week 1 reminders + 1 short case snapshot, week 2 last push + replay. Thoughts?

hannah.legal: For the webinar script & co-hosting, we need a brief written agreement: permission to record, permission to use quotes in marketing, and clarification that no PHI will be disclosed. If PHI present, marketing materials must be redacted and webinar may be for invited attendees only.

mike.design: I'll prepare a webinar hero, social cards, and a short 30s clip from the live demo. Need the customer's logo and headshots for co-hosts.

lina.marketing: I'll ask VeroHealth for: 1) logo; 2) confirmation of no PHI in the materials; 3) permission to record; 4) a one-line quote. Also propose a slot: Wed 2pm ET in 3 weeks.

(5h later)
lina.marketing: VeroHealth replies: "We confirm no PHI will be shared. You have permission to record and use our quote and logo (web/social). We'll provide a logo and a quote attributed to \"Dr. Mei Chen, Head of ML\". We'd like to review the webinar slide deck 48h before." Attached file: verohealth-logo.svg

hannah.legal: Good. That covers the legal checklist. Make sure Dr. Mei signs off on the quote in writing. Also note: since they'll review slides, include us on the review to avoid claims about product capabilities.

ben.pm: Noted. For the webinar flow, I'll draft a 30-minute agenda: 10m customer story, 10m demo, 10m live Q&A. Keep Q&A moderated.

mike.design: Uploading initial hero comp to PR. Planning 9:16 + 1:1 assets. Need the headshot for Dr. Mei.

webinar-bot: Scheduled webinar: "Optimizing Clinical Inference with VeroHealth" Wed 2:00pm ET in 3 weeks. Webinar registration page: https://redwood.ai/webinars/verohealth

lina.marketing: Great. I'll start the email sequence draft and tag content for A/B testing on subject lines. Also will add CTA: "Register for webinar" + link to a short case snapshot that will go live same day.

hannah.legal: After VeroHealth reviews slides, post them here with their approval note. We'll give final release sign-off on marketing materials.

lina.marketing: Thanks team. Will follow up with a PR for assets and the webinar script by EOD tomorrow.
